verdict.rationale: Feitian documents W3C WebAuthn compatibility and FIDO U2F registration and authentication over USB, NFC and BLE. It also provides guides for Google Advanced Protection, Microsoft applications and Azure AD, and registering keys with online accounts in general, which covers the core of the cross-service second-factor story. Missing for 10: any password-manager-specific evidence, GitHub web-login 2FA documentation (only OpenSSH/GitHub SSH use is covered), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
